title: Two more community apps entered the garden
summary:
A community harvest: two new apps in the showcase, a quicker Polly, and quieter maintenance keeping the garden watered.

The app showcase now includes Multimodal Image Generator, an open-source CLI and web interface for configurable image generation, plus DREAMMELD for AI dream interpretation and visualization. More things people made with the API, now easier to stumble across.

Polly's update brings faster code indexing, improved prompts, collaborator permissions, and fewer opportunities for tool loops to wander into the woods. AGENTS.md was also compressed by roughly 55% while retaining its actionable rules, so developers and agents spend less context reading instructions.

Daily metrics, health checks, README community highlights, and secure contributor access were refreshed. The directory remains current while development work on Bedrock integrations has another securely configured pair of hands.
